6118-original.D: Preserving a control character means the decoded JSON string contains the original character. Replacing it with a space gives a different string even when both outputs are valid JSON.
6118-original.E: The example uses a table stored in a local database file. The reader can inspect the resulting text after the program finishes reading the local file as part of the inspection.
6118-original.author: D/E written for this experiment, checked against paired native fixtures; B/C recorded teacher demonstrations.
